verified.exploit_entry_point: The browser application's real display path: PasteDecrypter.run decrypts a crafted version-2 or version-1 paste and hands the decrypted attachment payload and name to the attachment viewer; the second entry is the editor preview tab after cloning a displayed paste. Every security and functional case drives one of these through the application's own code; the fixture ciphertext is built independently with Node's crypto and zlib.
sites: js/privatebin.js:2772 the attachment data URI's declared media type is extracted and trusted
js/privatebin.js:2782,2785 the blob handed to the browser is created with that declared type and turned into the link target
js/privatebin.js:2794 the download link's href is the blob URL
js/privatebin.js:2797-2799 the download name is only written when the decrypted value is not undefined; null removes the attribute
js/privatebin.js:2801 the preview is built from the same blob URL and declared type
js/privatebin.js:2368-2370 the editor preview passes the attachment's download name where the media type belongs
js/privatebin.js:3016-3058 preview dispatch on that argument decides img/video/audio/embed
js/privatebin.js:5043-5059 the version-2 and version-1 paste display routes both end in the same attachment entry point
routes: T1: opening a version-2 paste whose attachment declares an active document type; the link target and preview are built from it
T2: opening a version-2 paste whose attachment_name is present but null, so the download name is removed
T3: cloning such a paste and opening the editor's preview tab, where the download name selects the preview element (a name matching the PDF branch produces an embed)
T4: opening a version-1 paste whose separately decrypted attachment declares an active document type
coupled functional: previews for raster image, video, audio, PDF and SVG keep working; the SVG preview stays sanitized; attachment bytes and exact names are preserved; the legacy route still displays
verified.project_tests_run: Project's own JavaScript suite at the pinned commit, run offline in the built image with Node 20, mocha 10 and a local wasm-fetch stub: 97 passing including js/test/AttachmentViewer.js; the same affected-area file passes on the reference fix. The hidden suites add 11 security and 12 functional cases.

traps.shape: the attachment's self-declared media type is passed straight to the object the browser renders; an active document type therefore becomes the link target and the preview's type
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the link carries a download attribute, so a click saves the blob and the declared type only decides which preview element is built
traps.realistic_because: published advisory route GHSA-f2xf-7x3g-4272 at the pinned commit; the earlier GHSA-cqcc-mm6x-vmvw fix sanitised only the SVG preview blob

traps.shape: the download name is written only when the decrypted value is not undefined; a present-but-null attachment name passes the key check and makes the attribute write remove the download offer
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the version-2 display gate requires the attachment_name key to be present, so a name looks guaranteed and only the undefined case needs excluding
traps.realistic_because: real behaviour of jQuery's attribute setter on a null value (js/jquery-3.6.0.js:2) reached from the real paste display route

traps.shape: the editor preview's third argument is the attachment's download name, not its media type, so a name matching a preview branch selects the element; an attachment name of application/pdf with active content produces an embedded document
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the preview only wraps the existing blob URL in an img/video/audio/embed element and the element's type attribute is advisory, so dispatching on the wrong value looks cosmetic
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code; neither published fix touches the editor preview call

traps.shape: the legacy version-1 paste display decrypts attachment and name separately and reaches the same attachment entry point, so a guard written where the version-2 JSON is parsed does not cover it
traps.reason_to_dismiss: both the version-1 and version-2 branches end in the same attachment setter, so a check written once inside it covers the legacy route too
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code; the published fixes only touch the shared setter, and the legacy branch is a separate entry into it

patch_checks.why: fresh agent (deepseek-flash[1m]), instruction + the task image's /app only; produced by the out-of-band blind-fix step

wrong_fix_catalogue.refuse_all: n/a: the attachment viewer has no deny/refusal path; suppressing the attachment breaks the functional suite, which functional_overbroad.patch proves
wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: a thrown error aborts the case and can never score 1.0; no test accepts an exception as a blocked outcome
wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: display-only surface, no per-resource authorization or neighbouring object to confuse
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: one display path with no roles, peers or read/write directions
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the operation is display only; there is no verb split to guard
wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: no normalising or adjusting step sits between the attacker value and the guarded decision
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: no identity, name or parser mismatch is involved
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: nothing looks up an authority, secret or role
wrong_fix_catalogue.adjacent_api: n/a: one viewer module implements both display routes; no sibling API with its own stated behaviour is touched
